credits.title: Drive - The Pretenders
credits.overview: A young mechanic fakes an engagement with racing's most scandalous star — officially for his reputation, secretly for her own shot behind the wheel. But soon the lie threatens to destroy everything — including what's already become so much more than just a deal.

credits.title: Wo die Stille tötet - Mord in der Wüste
credits.overview: When her son Dominik disappears without a trace in Namibia, Hannah Jansen, a cashier from Berlin, travels to Africa on her own. She is accompanied by Vincent, a seemingly harmless tour guide. Together, they uncover a web of corruption, geopolitical interests, and personal guilt.

credits.title: Steirergift
credits.overview: The investigation into the death of a young woman who was drugged with knockout drops and raped leads the Graz duo to Leoben.

credits.title: Drifter
credits.overview: Moritz follows a boyfriend to Berlin and is soon abandoned by him. Alone in the big city, he embarks on a journey through a wide range of queer experience. Only through a new circle of queer friends does he develop his own ideas of sexuality and masculinity, leading him to a clearer self-identity.

credits.title: Songs of a Caretaker
credits.overview: The shy Hugo is a caretaker in a prefabricated building. He feels at home here, is appreciated by the residents and sings his songs in the corridors. credits.title: Die Verteidigerin - Der Gesang des Raben
All for Ella
credits.overview: Ella and her friends sign up for a song contest that offers her the chance to make it big in the music business. Her strongest competitor is rapper alfaMK, who already has a fan base and is also outrageously good-looking.

credits.title: Dark Dreamers
credits.overview: 17-year-old Rebekka is feeling hollow and empty after her brother Dennis died by suicide two years ago. Dennis' friend Vincent is the only one who can help her through this difficult time. But Vincent is an outsider, accepted by nobody, especially since he jumped off the bridge with Dennis and survived.

credits.title: Das Wasser des Lebens
credits.overview: King Ansgar is dying and wants to name one of his two sons as his successor. Lennard, the youngest, is wise and is got heart. His brother Falk is thirsty for power and belligerent.
